proof.local_haar_support: A one-link rotation outside a source support leaves the source unchanged, so its actual response energy vanishes. Oscillation at most M bounds every remaining response and its Haar average by M^2; summing gives card(T)*M^2.
proof.actual_plaquette_upper: The real fundamental trace has absolute value at most 2 and a plaquette uses at most four links. Thus totalEnergy(plaquette)<=4*4^2=64, under the actual ground law for every beta>=0.
proof.direct_lower_budget: The actual variance floor 1/[24*(exp(36)+1)*(beta+1)^4], together with direct Haar coercivity applied to that gauge-invariant plaquette, forces 1<=1536*(exp(36)+1)*(beta+1)^4*A_H. This does not reuse the stronger A>=1/4 heat-bath-specific constraint.
proof.slab_binding: Variance monotonicity along the original physical transfer and time summation give k*Var(P^k f)<=A_H*sum_j totalEnergy(P^(j+1) f). Combining with a matching upper loss estimate yields the same A_H*kappa/(k+A_H*kappa) coefficient, now from the direct Haar premise.
proof.logarithmic_budget: The existing normalized Haar cap is at least (m+1)/8 at beta_m=log(m+2)/8. The new direct lower budget and rate<=r<1 then imply (1-r)*N_links<=12288*(exp(36)+1)*(beta_m+1)^4*r.
proof.explicit_growing_volume: The exponential Taylor inequality gives log(m+2)^2<=2*(m+2), hence (beta_m+1)^4<=4*(m+2)^2. With N_links=3*(m+2)^3, cancellation gives (1-r)*(m+2)<=16384*(exp(36)+1)*r.
proof.no_uniform_or_eventual_cap: The certified rate has the explicit lower bound (m+2)/(m+2+16384*(exp(36)+1)). Choosing an arbitrarily large integer cutoff contradicts any fixed strict cap, including a cap assumed only beyond some initial cutoff.
proof.scope: The mathematical object bounded from below is the proved upper-bound coefficient. No analogous lower bound on the actual transfer ratio is asserted.
